# KeyUI

## [v4.4.0](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/tree/v4.4.0) (2026-11-15)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/compare/v4.3.2...v4.4.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/releases)

- fix: keep keys from swallowing keypresses while KeyUI is open  
    Report on 4.4.0-beta4 (Forever 1.60.1): with KeyUI open, no keypress  
    reached the game for the first ~30 seconds.  
    Since 1b9e821 every key gets its OnKeyDown, OnMouseWheel and  
    OnGamePadButtonDown handlers at creation. If setting such a handler  
    leaves the frame taking that input, all keys swallowed keypresses (they  
    do not propagate). In locked mode the handler switched off only the key  
    that had just swallowed one, so input came back only after each key had  
    taken a press, or after the pointer had crossed the keys (OnLeave).  
    Nothing documents whether SetScript turns input on, so the fix does not  
    depend on it:  
    - InstallKeyEditHandlers switches input off right after setting them  
    - addon:ReleaseKeyCapture() switches it off on every key except the one  
      hovered in edit mode; called on open, at combat start and when a device  
      leaves edit mode (Cancel or Save: the hovered key gets no OnLeave then)  
    - /keyui report shows capture= keypress=<on|off>  
    The harness now assumes setting an input handler turns that input on and  
    checks that no locked key takes input after opening, during and after an  
    edit session, in combat and in the report. Without the fix it reports 20  
    problems, with it none on all five clients.  
    Not tested in-game.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- docs: record the layout name checks for testers and the harness  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: ask before a save replaces another custom layout  
    Typing the name of an existing custom layout into the Save Layout dialog replaced that  
    layout without a word. Now KEYUI\_LAYOUT\_OVERWRITE asks first ("A Keyboard layout named  
    '%s' already exists. Replace it?", name passed as a format argument). Replace saves;  
    Cancel or ESC goes back to the name dialog, so the edits can be saved under another name  
    or cancelled.  
    Saving the custom layout that is being edited under its own name still replaces it  
    without asking, since that is the usual way to keep changes to it. "Being edited" means  
    it is the active layout, compared by content because layout\_current and layout\_edited  
    are separate tables after /reload.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: reopen a custom layout that shares a built-in layout's name  
    Players who saved a custom layout under a built-in layout's name before that was refused  
    still lost it on every /reload: addon:load() opens the active layout by name before the  
    layout menu exists, and generate\_\_layout took the built-in table first.  
    layout\_current\_ keeps a copy of the layout that was active, so the lookup  
    (addon:ResolveLayoutByName) now takes the custom layout when it matches that copy and the  
    built-in one otherwise. No saved data is renamed or rewritten. The harness reopens KeyUI  
    as after /reload with such a pair, once with the custom and once with the built-in layout  
    active.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: keep custom layouts off the built-in layout names  
    A custom layout saved, renamed or copied under a built-in layout's internal name  
    ("QWERTZ\_100%", "Layout\_4x3", "xbox") was replaced by the built-in layout the next time  
    KeyUI opened: addon:load() looks the active layout up by name before the layout menu  
    exists, and generate\_\_layout prefers the built-in table.  
    Saving, renaming and copying now refuse those names with a chat line, and importing (and  
    the copy suggestion) picks " (2)" instead. A refused name in the Save Layout dialog  
    keeps the dialog open; it used to close it and leave the device edited with nothing on  
    screen to save or discard the edits.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: record a saved layout as the current board  
    Saving a layout made it the current one in layout\_current\_ but left  
    key\_bind\_settings\_.currentboard on the layout picked before. Every other way to  
    pick a layout sets both, and RenameLayout only renames currentboard when it names the  
    renamed layout, so renaming a just-saved layout left currentboard pointing at a name  
    that was no longer current. The harness now saves a layout on each device.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- chore: settle the remaining luacheck warnings  
    No behaviour change. The only warnings that pointed at code were two fallbacks to globals  
    no client has any more: IsAddOnLoaded behind C\_AddOns.IsAddOnLoaded and  
    ToggleAutoCastPetAction behind C\_ActionBar.ToggleAutoCastPetAction. The namespaced  
    functions exist in all five GlobalAPI dumps, so the fallbacks never ran; they are gone.  
    The rest is tidying: the unused addon name from the file vararg (and the thirty  
    shadowing warnings it caused), unused locals, repeated `local text`, an empty if branch,  
    and handle\_drag\_or\_size/handle\_release, which declared a parameter named self next to  
    the implicit one of the method.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- chore: lint with luacheck in CI  
    .luacheckrc checks KeyUI's own Lua with luacheck 1.2.0; pr-check.yml runs it as a  
    separate job. The part that matters is "accessing undefined variable": the WoW globals  
    KeyUI may read come from tools/luacheck/wow\_globals.lua, generated by  
    tools/luacheck-globals.lua from the Blizzard resources of all five clients plus the  
    top-level definitions in their UI source. A name no client defines stays an error, and  
    the generator prints the names some client lacks so their guards can be checked.  
    Names that only the Blizzard\_Deprecated* forwarders define are allowed in Core.lua and  
    Frames/ActionButton.lua, the two files that use them as fallbacks behind C\_ActionBar.  
    The harness stand-in may set the globals it emulates, but not through allow\_defined:  
    luacheck shares implicitly defined globals across the files of one run, which hid every  
    undefined global in the addon in a first attempt.  
    tools/update-api.sh fetches the extra resource files (FrameXML, Frames, Mixins,  
    LuaEnum, Events, GlobalStrings/enUS) and gains "resources" to refresh only those.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- docs: record today's snapshots, combat-only controls, popups and Classic atlases  
    Snapshot table at Retail 70783 and Forever 70938; both tab templates now  
    exist on every client; the controller glyph atlases are missing on  
    Anniversary and Classic Era; which controls refuse during combat; secret  
    strings and popup rules; what the harness now covers; tester checks for  
    the fixes since beta1; Forever in the supported versions and the TOC line.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: let layouts with a % in their name be deleted  
    The client formats every popup text with SetFormattedText (GameDialog.lua),  
    and the delete confirmation built its text by concatenating the layout  
    name. A name such as "50% keys" made the popup raise "invalid option"  
    instead of asking. The name is now passed as the popup's text argument.  
    Harness: popups format their text like the client; step 31c deletes a  
    layout named "50% keys".  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: record the selected custom layout as the current board  
    Selecting a default layout set key\_bind\_settings\_.currentboard,  
    selecti

## [v4.3.2](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/tree/v4.3.2) (2026-11-14)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/compare/v4.3.1...v4.3.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/releases)

- fix: keep the profile buttons out of the Options search  
    Typing in the Options search box on WoW Forever raised  
    ADDON\_ACTION\_FORBIDDEN for C\_Discord.IsUserOAuthed, blamed on KeyUI.  
    CreateSettingsButtonInitializer adds a button's search tags from the  
    calling addon's code, so the three profile buttons (Export, Import, Full  
    Reset) carried tainted tags. The search reads every initializer's tags,  
    and its result list then shows Blizzard's Discord sign-in row from  
    tainted code. The checkboxes, dropdown and slider are not affected: their  
    tags are added inside SettingsInbound's secure attribute handler.  
    Passing addSearchTags = false keeps the buttons out of the search. The  
    argument must stay a boolean; the function asserts on nil. Same signature  
    on all five clients. This is Blizzard bug WoWUIBugs#873; other addons  
    confirmed the workaround in-game on Forever.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- ci: move actions/checkout to v7 (Node 24)  
    Every run warned that actions/checkout@v4 targets the deprecated Node.js 20  
    and is being forced onto Node.js 24. v7 runs on Node 24 natively. Nothing  
    here depends on what changed in between: v6 moved persisted credentials to a  
    separate file (the packager uses GITHUB\_OAUTH, not git credentials) and v7  
    only blocks fork checkouts under pull\_request\_target and workflow\_run, which  
    these workflows do not use.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# KeyUI

## [v4.3.1](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/tree/v4.3.1) (2026-10-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/compare/v4.3.0...v4.3.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/1onar/KeyUI/releases)

- feat: support WoW Forever  
    Forever (1.60.1, interface 16001) plays in classic Azeroth but runs the  
    Mainline client: the 12.1.5 API with secret values, the Mainline templates  
    and atlases, and none of the legacy spell globals. Its build number fell in  
    the isVanilla range, so KeyUI would have taken the Classic Era paths there:  
    bundled BLPs instead of atlases, no ActionButtonSpellFXTemplate, no combat  
    lock on action changes and no BINDINGS\_LOADED.  
    VersionCompat gains isForever and isModern (Retail or Forever). Everything  
    that follows the client rather than the game now checks isModern, and  
    USE\_ATLAS follows it. Retail and the Classic clients keep their flags. The  
    combat-lock message no longer says "on Retail".  
    Checked against the 1.60.1.70450 dump; no Forever client was available to  
    test in-game. COMPATIBILITY.md documents the new snapshot layout and re-runs  
    the API audit against all five clients.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- chore: pull API snapshots from wow-ui-source and watch for new builds  
    API/ held hand-made client exports named after their build, so every bump  
    meant re-exporting four clients and rewriting the paths in COMPATIBILITY.md.  
    tools/update-api.sh now fetches the Interface/AddOns tree of the matching  
    Gethe/wow-ui-source branch into API//, plus the atlas, global API  
    and template lists from Ketho/BlizzardInterfaceResources, which stand in for  
    the Helix folder wow-ui-source does not carry. Before it replaces a snapshot  
    it lists which API documentation files changed.  
    `check` compares each branch's version.txt with the Interface line of  
    KeyUI.toc. The API Watch workflow runs it every Monday and opens one issue  
    per interface version the TOC does not list yet.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
